audited_statement: Stable Q-side transversal seed plus unique-parent uncovered heads gives stable signed physical-monomer polynomial and actual-degree real-rooted support polynomial under independent nonnegative endpoint activities
qualifications: ordinary unweighted seed basis polynomial must be real stable
every head outside Q has indegree at most one
endpoint weights are independent nonnegative tail/head products
explicit_seed: For q>=2 all nonempty Q-neighborhoods singleton or universal; q=0,1 handled separately
physical_overlap: Allowed without restriction beyond original looplessness
degree: Actual surviving support degree, including activity-induced rank drops
